<thought>We need to place a CO₂ molecule on the TiO₂ slab. The adsorption site JSON is empty, so we’ll use the default placement with a height of 2.0 Å. I will provide a minimal valid CO₂ CIF (including required loops and occupancy) to the add_adsorbate_to_slab_text tool, then write the resulting combined CIF to a file and return its path.</thought>
<action>add_adsorbate_to_slab_text</action>
